properties.title: M/V Ocean Crescent , GOMEX south of Pensacola, FL
properties.content:
At 2353 PDT USCG Sector Mobile, AL contacted the NOAA ERD duty officer to request a trajectory for an oil spill.  The master of the M/V Ocean Crescent reported to the CG (at 2300PDT) spilling 7.3 cubic meters of IFO-380 as a result of a fuel transfer error. Spill location given as N29deg 07' 24" and W87deg 09' 12", which is in the Gulf of Mexico approximately 70 mi south of Pensacola, FL.

A trajectory is being prepared.

M/V Ocean Crescent , GOMEX south of Pensacola, FL

2012-08-03
At 2353 PDT USCG Sector Mobile, AL contacted the NOAA ERD duty officer to request a trajectory for an oil spill. The master of the M/V Ocean Crescent reported to the CG (at 2300PDT) spilling 7.3 cubic meters of IFO-380 as a result of a fuel transfer error. Spill location given as N29deg 07' 24" and W87deg 09' 12", which is in the Gulf of Mexico approximately 70 mi south of Pensacola, FL. A trajectory is being prepared.
